digest.component_or_area: store initialization and usability checking (_reads, event_prepare, store_usability)
propositions: A directory that exists but lacks .git, resolvable HEAD, or store structure returns [] instead of raising store_uninitialized, making broken stores indistinguishable from empty ones.
The read-side guard (os.path.isdir only) disagrees with the write-side guard (.git presence check), allowing inconsistent store validity judgments between reads and writes.
Materialized snapshots (.git-less directories with .store-compat.json and event dirs) must remain readable but were rejected by a .git-requiring predicate, breaking gate-agent production reads.

The fix unifies read and write paths through one shared store_is_usable predicate: isdir AND ((.git + resolvable HEAD) OR (.store-compat.json) OR (≥1 event dir)), with HEAD probe bounded by gitutil.run_git_bounded to preserve lock-held timeout invariants.
